title: Final Project: Build a Responsive Website
description: Apply all the concepts learned throughout the course to build a fully responsive, modern website from scratch.

lessons.title: Project Overview and Requirements
lessons.content: Understand the project goals, requirements, and design brief.

lessons.title: Setting Up Project Structure
lessons.content: Create folders and files for HTML, CSS, assets, and organize the project.

lessons.title: Building the Header and Navigation
lessons.content: Create responsive navigation using Flexbox and CSS Grid.

lessons.title: Creating Responsive Layout Sections
lessons.content: Use CSS Grid and media queries to build content sections.

lessons.title: Styling Buttons and Forms
lessons.content: Design accessible buttons and forms with hover and focus effects.

lessons.title: Incorporating CSS Animations and Transitions
lessons.content: Add subtle animations and transitions to enhance user experience.

lessons.title: Optimizing for Different Devices
lessons.content: Refine media queries and flexible units for tablets and mobiles.

lessons.title: Accessibility and Best Practices
lessons.content: Ensure your website is accessible and follows CSS best practices.

lessons.title: Testing and Debugging CSS Issues
lessons.content: Use browser tools to debug layout, performance, and responsiveness.

lessons.title: Final Submission and Review
lessons.content: Prepare your project for submission, peer review, and deployment tips.
